items.title: Marathon Petroleum And 2 Top Pipeline Stocks
items.summary: Oil markets are again flashing signs of oversupply as high prices curb demand, yet the pipes, tanks and terminals that move hydrocarbons still sit at the center of global trade flows. That gap between softer crude prices and steady transport needs can create a window for investors who prefer toll-road style energy exposure. items.title: 3 Refining Stocks To Watch As Cheaper Crude Tests Margins
items.summary: Oil markets have quietly flipped from scarcity headlines to talk of surplus, with weaker demand, fuller tanks and a softer geopolitical risk premium all pulling on crude prices at once. That shift can reshape the economics of refiners and petrochemical producers, changing who benefits from cheaper feedstock and who simply earns less on every barrel processed.
